population_authority: the exact 514-asset physical V2 base snapshot; no outcome-conditioned additions or removals
decision_time_rule: decision_timestamp = source five-minute bar start + 5 minutes
session_rule: XNYS regular session only, including calendar-declared early-close sessions; pre-market and after-hours rows are ineligible
identity_rule: require admitted canonical asset identity and unique asset_id/decision_timestamp
feature_rule: V2 composite row exists and all non-null values are finite; natural lookback nulls use only the frozen family preprocessing
training_rule: target_is_trainable is true, target resolution is MATURED_VALID, decision_timestamp < refit_T, and target_available_timestamp <= refit_T
scoring_rule: feature row is available at score T; target maturity is not required at score time
ranking_rule: at least two eligible assets at a decision timestamp; no silent population fill
short_lane_common_sample_rule: intersection of eligible decision timestamps and assets across compared qualifier families where input semantics permit
missing_bar_rule: target authority classification is preserved; missing required bars are never silently skipped into MATURED_VALID
future_holdout_rule: all history through 2026-09-23 is development; prospective validation begins 2026-09-24
